response.sql:
WITH matched_by_type AS (
  SELECT 
    o.ordertune,
    COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(type_count) as avg_count
  FROM matched_by_type
)
SELECT 
  AVG(mbt.type_count) as avg_of_above_average_counts,
  AVG(mbt.type_count - oa.avg_count) as avg_excess_over_overall_avg
FROM matched_by_type mbt
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE mbt.type_count > oa.avg_count

assumptions.assumption: Risk/margin-matched orders are defined by riskandmargin.ordervault = orders.recordvault; the INNER JOIN excludes unmatched records as requested
'Types above the average' means ordertune values whose matched count exceeds the average count across all order types (using strict inequality >)
